YOU CAN BE A BELIEVER IN CHRIST AND NOT EVER GROW NEAR THE SPIRITUALITY OF THE SAME CHRIST YOU BELIEVED. (Sequel to my post on angels of ministries and their ranks)
I see a lot of people who are hell bent on quoting scriptures from the letters just to support a claim.
Even a claim that has nothing to do with the truth.
And I also see a few who says the truth but they don't look for scriptures to defend what they say. Only the discerning will understand them because there are certain information the bible doesn't even say verbatim too. But if you look closely, such truth are never against the scriptures.
I was telling someone that the word ministry is not limited to the gospel or church. I told him that every job is a ministry. And for believers in Christ our ministry is in what we do for living. You don't have think you can't influence for God on that job you do for living
A doctor, a farmer,a trader,who is a believer in Christ has a ministry to fulfill for God which may not be inside the walls of religion. Yet in their various places of work, they influence for God and rescue souls into the kingdom. And you want to say that is not ministry?
Abraham and Lot were farmers,yet they influenced for God in their generatio.n. That is ministry
Saul and David were warriors, yet they influenced for God in their generation. That is ministry.
Paul and Demas were lawyers and yet served God until Demas left Paul. The bible didn't say Demas left God. ,only that he loved this present world... They did ministry.
Onesimus and Philemon were master and slave who served God's purpose. That is ministry
Judas Iscariot and Jesus had pure gospel ministry too. Until Judas left and kpai himself.
STUDY HOW THESE MEN LEFT EACH OTHER AND OBSERVE WHAT TRANSPIRED BETWEEN THEIR MINISTERING ANGELS. Between them as co-laborers and as masters to associates.
Every ministry influencing for God has ministering angels assigned to it by the Holy Spirit.
Every ministry influencing for Satan has demonic angels assigned to it by Lucifer
You don't have to deny the existence of angels whether from God or from fallen Satan. And they are always behind every physical positive or negative influences we see in the physical world.
There is no ministry for God by anyone without her ministering angels.
Each church or gospel ministry has their ministering angels under the authority of the Holy Spirit and we don't control them. God does.
Those who control angels are probably controlling the fallen ones who are on deception spree to decieve. A lot of people doing ministry have allowed this infiltration due to lack of knowledge or quick selfish gratification.
Yes they are messangers but they are not supposed to be influenced by us but by God on our behalf. Alas,Satan has lowered down the standard of God because he is fallen already and his fallen associates are not under God's jurisdiction again. Reason we must be careful never to open up to any angel who's not under control of God. We must test every spirit.
So,you see all gospel assignment has angels who are ministering spirits sent by the Holy Ghost for that assignment. A lot doesn't know that Holy Spirit are always sending angels to minister to us when we pray. They are His errand boys and every ministry has them.
Let me even come down to the level of work apprenticeship. Do you know everyone has personal angels assigned from God ? And they have ranks?
Reason an apprentice may not succeed without obtaining the an evidence in form of certification or blessing of his master is because there is orderliness control room where the spirit of men obtain pass. If you leave without following that process,you may be heading for a fall in that hardwork. Nobody will employ someone without certificate.
If it is God leading you out of a ministry where you served. Same God will give you wisdom on how to go about leaving that ministry or church.
If you follow God verbatim without asking for the wisdom to go about it. You will be surprised same God will blame you for obeying Him blindly without asking questions.
This is because wisdom is better than obedience. Just as obedience is better than sacrifice.
I rest my case for a while here.
Your brother
Latunde Akin
